s.d: literally: to stretch out (one's) tent; hence: = causative action by which humans erect their tent by stretching out the tent curtains over a structure of poles
literally: to stretch oneself out; hence: = action by which humans lie down in a certain place
literally: to stretch out (one's hand or neck); hence: = action by which humans straighten part of their body, such as their hands or necks
s.g: to stretch out (part of one's body)

s.d: literally: outstretched arm or hand; hence: = action by which deities exert strength and power
action by which humans leave the main road to interrupt their journey or take a side road
causative action by which humans cause (other) humans or animals to leave the main road to interrupt their journey or take a side road
literally: to turn aside (from the right way); hence: = action by which humans deviate from what is considered to be the right way to conduct their lives

literally: to cause (someone) to turn aside (from the right way); hence: = causative action by which humans cause (other) humans to deviate from what is considered to be the right way to conduct their lives
s.g: to cause (others) to turn (from the right way)

s.d: literally: to turn aside; hence: = action by which humans settle down in a place away from their original community
literally: to turn (to a certain activity); hence: = action by which humans engage in a certain activity
literally: to turn (an event) away; hence: = causative action by which humans prevent certain events from taking place
literally: (one's) heart turns (in a certain direction); hence: = action by which humans focus their thoughts and attention on a person, deity, or activity
s.g: (one's) heart turns (in a certain direction); to focus (one's) attention

s.d: literally: to turn (one's) heart (in a certain direction); hence: = action by which humans focus their thoughts and attention on a person, deity, or activity
s.g: to turn (one's) heart (in a certain direction); to focus (one's) attention

s.d: literally: to cause (someone's) heart to turn aside; hence: = causative action by which humans or deities cause (other) humans to focus their thoughts and attention on a person, deity or activity
s.g: to cause (someone's) heart to turn; to cause (someone) to focus their attention

s.d: literally: to turn (from something); hence: = action by which humans stop focusing their thoughts and attention on a certain activity
s.g: to turn (one's) heart (in a certain direction); to focus (one's) attention

s.d: literally: to turn (someone) away; hence: = action by which humans or deities show their unwillingness to help (other) humans
literally: to turn behind (someone); hence: = action by which humans take the side of a certain party, implying that they reject other parties
s.g: to take sides (with someone); to support

s.d: town; ◄ territory of {L:Judah<SDBH:יְהוּדָה>}
action by which humans determine the weight of an object, which is usually done with the help of a balance (scales)
vegetation, ◄ intentionally sown or planted by humans
ornament worn around the neck
literally: spreading out; hence: = a secondary woody stem arising from the trunk or bough of a tree or the main stem of a shrub
causative action by which humans or forces take hold of objects and cause them to rise up from a certain location
literally: to lift up (and lay) on someone else; hence: = causative action by which deities cause humans to undergo a certain event
to lift up (one's eyes); hence: = action by which humans direct their face or eyes away from the ground so that they can see what is in the distance or in the sky
literally: to lift up (over someone else); hence: = action by which a deity offers several options for humans to choose from
state in which objects are relatively heavy

action of placing a seed or small plant in the ground so that it will grow and produce ≈ used symbolically to describe God's act of giving the people of Israel their own land, as promised to their ancestors
action by which humans erect a temporary place of residence ◄ by putting stakes in the ground
action by which deities bring something into existince ◄ as if they were pitching a tent
vegetation, ◄ intentionally sown or planted by humans
action of placing a seed or small plant in the ground so that it will grow and produce
town; ◄ territory of {L:Judah<SDBH:יְהוּדָה>}; ► residence of potters
process by which liquids flow in small drops
literally: a mountain causes to drip; hence: = process by which liquids flow in small drops on a mountain
literally: to cause to drip (words); hence: = action by which humans speak or act as a prophet
a minimal portion of a liquid
gum resin (or sap) of the Liquidambar or storax tree; the sap is aromatic; ◄ Liquidambar orientalis; ► used for the preparation of fragrant incense
literally: fruit of table; hence: = meat that is sacrificed on the altar
literally: fruit of lips; hence: = words conveying a positive message, such as praise, encouragement, etc.
man; ► chief; after exile
location; ◄ near {L:Ramah<SDBH:רָמָה>}, ► place where {L:David<SDBH:דָּוִד>} and {L:Samuel<SDBH:שְׁמוּאֵל>} went when the former had to flee from {L:Saul<SDBH:שָׁאוּל>}
state/process by which events last a long time
